notes: Partition verified: all 24 source IDs and all 23 target IDs occur exactly once across 25 units (24 source units plus one added unit).

'is due' is added under rules 5 and 103 on the licensing test rather than on recurrence: ἀποδότε and ὀφειλάς have both spent their English, the clause is elliptical in Greek, and no token's expression is left incomplete. Reading it as a discontinuous second realization of ὀφειλάς under rule 15 remains defensible, as rule 103 concedes.

All four τῷ datives are analysed alike as substantival articles rendered 'to whom' with the case preposition riding along (rules 21, 22), and every accusative article stands unrepresented because the ASV gives its noun no determiner (rule 23).
